description.narrative: The Project Developement Objectives are to support the establishment of key building blocks of the national social safety net system and to improve access to targeted cash transfers for poor and vulnerable households

The development objectives of the Social Safety Net System Project for Mauritania are to support the establishment of key building blocks of the national social safety net system and to provide targeted cash transfers to extreme poor households. The project comprises of three components. The first component, support to national social safety net system objective is to support the central government's capacity for the establishment and coordination of the national social safety net system. It consists of following two sub-components: (i) implementation of the national social registry; and (ii) support to the implementation of the national social protection strategy. The second component, support to social transfer program objective is to support the design and implementation of the social transfer program. It consists of following three sub-components: (i) development of program tools and processes, monitoring and evaluation and operational costs; (ii) payment of transfers to beneficiaries; and (iii) promotion of investment in human capital and resilience. The third component, project management will support activities related to the management of the project.

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved/target surpassed: There were approximately 660,000 extreme poor the country at the time of Appraisal, living in approximately 100,000 households, which was then adopted as the target for the program (original target). With the introduction of the Elmaouna program at restructuring, the target was revised to 706,200 individuals, counting total individual beneficiaries of the Tekavoul and Elmaouna programs. For consistency, in the ISRs, the indicator was then tracked as referring to households instead of individuals (target according to ISR11: 211,200, corresponding to 32,000 households). 244,679.00 individuals were included in the Tekavoul program, as such, the target of 211,200 individuals was surpassed. </p>

<p>Similarly, the target for the following sub-indicator of this indicator was also revised in the ISRs and the target was surpassed: </p>

<ul>
 <li>Beneficiaries of Safety Nets programs - Tekavoul transfers program (number) - Financed by the project (Number, Custom Breakdown). Target: 165,000.00; Actual at completion: 224,624.00. Target surpassed. </li>
</ul>
